e5e8d28b5b274873f54b6489b5487529e1d698e0.sourceText:
| 转换方式 | 通常的运行开销 |
|:---|:---|
| `static_cast` | 不会因为使用这种写法而增加额外开销 |
| `dynamic_cast` | 需要在运行时检查对象的真实类型，可能产生时间和程序体积开销 |
| `const_cast` | 通常只改变编译器进行类型检查的方式，没有运行时操作 |
| `reinterpret_cast` | 通常只改变编译器解释数据的方式，没有额外转换步骤 |
e5e8d28b5b274873f54b6489b5487529e1d698e0.translatedText:
| Conversion method | Typical runtime overhead |
|:---|:---|
| `static_cast` | No additional overhead is introduced by using this form |
| `dynamic_cast` | The object's actual type needs to be checked at runtime, which may incur time and program size overhead |
| `const_cast` | Usually only changes the way the compiler performs type checking, with no runtime operation |
| `reinterpret_cast` | Usually only changes the way the compiler interprets the data, with no additional conversion step |

| 处理方式 | 4 m内借入的近场 | 4 m外自身计算 |
|---|---|---|
| 自身点云降采样尺度 | 0.05 m | 0.1 m |
| 写死的地面格子边长 | 0.2 m | 0.4 m |
| 相对估计地面的正常输出范围 | 非负、低于0.5 m | 绝对值、低于1.0 m |
| 低于估计地面的点 | 当前 `considerDrop=False`，被过滤 | 取绝对值，可能进入输出 |
| 最终相对输入高度窗口 | 固定上下界 | 随距离放宽 |

| Processing method | Near\-field borrowed within 4 m | Self\-computed beyond 4 m |
|---|---|---|
| Self point cloud downsampling scale | 0\.05 m | 0\.1 m |
| Hard\-coded ground grid cell edge length | 0\.2 m | 0\.4 m |
| Normal output range relative to the estimated ground | Non\-negative, below 0\.5 m | Absolute value, below 1\.0 m |
| Points below the estimated ground | Current `considerDrop=False`, filtered out | Take absolute value, may enter output |
| Final height window relative to input | Fixed upper and lower bounds | Relaxed with distance |
